summary: Correct, minimal fix that adds current_app to the reverse() call so readonly ForeignKey links resolve against the active custom admin site, consistent with how the rest of the admin (e.g. ModelAdmin.response_add) handles namespacing. Matches the actual upstream Django resolution for this ticket.

issues.description: Trailing comma after the current_app argument would better match Django's prevailing multi-line call style, but this is a pure formatting nit and not blocking.
